## `Round`

*Available in [R](#round-r)*
=== "R"
    !!! bug "Deprecated Function"
        This function has been deprecated, and will be removed in a future CIDAtools release.
    <h4>Description</h4>

    Shorter wrapper for format(x, digits = n, nsmall = n)

    <h4>Usage</h4>
    ```R

    Round(x, n)

    ```
    <h4>Arguments</h4>

    - `x` - numeric to be formatted
    - `n` - number of digits for nsmall

    <h4>Returns</h4>

    a character vector of same length of x converted
